name: Kettlebell Double Windmill
steps: Hold one bell overhead and the other at your opposite thigh, with both feet angled away from the overhead side.
Keep your eyes fixed on the overhead kettlebell and your top arm completely vertical and locked.
Shift the loaded hip back and hinge as the lower bell tracks down the inside of the opposite leg.
Squeeze your glutes and obliques to rise back to standing while keeping the top bell overhead, and switch sides after completing one side.
tips: Keep a slight softness in your front knee while keeping the rear leg straight under the overhead load.
Maintain a packed overhead shoulder and neutral spine throughout the hinge.
